title: The Duplicate Destroyer
functionCode:
def remove_target(nums:list[int], target:int) -> list[int]:
    return [num for num in nums if num != target]
description: I remove every instance of a specific number from your list!

testFeedback.feedback: Ensures that items not matching the target are kept intact. This is useful supporting evidence, and it is strongest when combined with coverage from another branch.
Correctly handles cases where the entire list consists of the target value. This is strong supporting evidence for boundary behavior and edge-condition reliability.

title: The Swap Specialist
functionCode:
def swap(nums:list[int]) -> list[int]:
    if len(nums) < 2: return nums
    nums[0] = nums[-1]
    nums[-1] = nums[0]
    return nums
description: I swap the first and last elements of any list.

testFeedback.feedback: The first assignment overwrites data, so both ends end up identical instead of swapping. This is useful supporting evidence, and it is strongest when combined with coverage from another branch.
